newsitem.title: DJIBOUTI: Refugees flee Eritrea camp to Djibouti.
newsitem.headline: Refugees flee Eritrea camp to Djibouti.

text.p: A group of 47 Somalis, mostly women and children, have arrived in northern Djibouti after fleeing their refugee camp in Eritrea, media reports said on Sunday.
Djibouti television said the group fled the camp in the Eritrean Red Sea port of Assab to Obock in northern Djibouti because they were short of food and medical attention.

"Many more are coming despite efforts by the Eritrean authorities to stop them," one refugee said in a TV interview. He said they had been in the Assab camp for the last 18 months, but did not say how they got there from Somalia, which borders Djibouti to the south.
